display_title: The Mastermind I Killed Came Back to Life
description:
A dark mastermind desperate to die and a heroine who reluctantly grants his wish—an unpredictable, sweet romance!/

After possessing someone else's body, Luana dreams of a wealthy life and attempts to rob the dark mastermind Eden's vault. Caught off guard by unexpected circumstances, she accidentally shoots him. Eden, thought dead, surprisingly revives. Along with his new resurrection ability, he gains the power to see a status window detailing missions tied to the world's survival...

Turns out, a divine intervention was behind Eden's special abilities?! With the arrival of Raphi, the cat sidekick character who's a messenger of the gods, Luana and Eden embark on a chaotic, desperate struggle to save the world!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
